retained_owner_rules: Only current exact successor packet IDs/files in exact_file_conflicts establish future handoff constraints; no historical compound path or predecessor packet label is a lease.
DR01 reduction and SSW07 correctness have separate scope/budgets/receipts. They may share a short backend file lease after each contract/review release; unrelated DR02 does not wait.
REPLAY-IP07 writes Interfaces guards, not already-correct State L3; canonical admission/runtime are read-only consumer inputs.
human_holds_and_foreign_owners: Compiler source, docs and tests remain with the compiler agent; only released producer inputs consumed.
Root owns queue/decisions/living-plan planning refresh; package defining owners own future finite code leases.
